verses.translation: And David spoke to the Lord the words of this song, in the day in which the Lord rescued him out of the hand of all his enemies, and out of the hand of Saul.

translations.ron: Atunci a cântat David cântarea aceasta Domnului, în ziua când Domnul l-a izbăvit de toţi vrăjmaşii lui şi din mâinile lui Saul, şi a zis:
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐλάλησε Δαυὶδ τῷ Κυρίῳ τοὺς λόγους τῆς ᾠδῆς ταύτης, ἐν ᾗ ἡμέρᾳ ἐξείλετο αὐτὸν Κύριος ἐκ χειρὸς πάντων τῶν ἐχθρῶν αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἐκ χειρὸς Σαούλ.

verses.translation: And the song was thus: O Lord, my rock, and my fortress, and my deliverer,

translations.ron: "Domnul este întărirea mea, scăparea mea şi izbăvitorul meu.
translations.grk: Καὶ εἶπεν ᾠδή· Κύριε πέτρα μου, καὶ ὀχύρωμά μου, καὶ ἐξαιρούμενός με ἐμοί,

verses.translation: my God; he shall be to me my guard, I will trust in him: he is my protector, and the horn of my salvation, my helper, and my sure refuge; thou shalt save me from the unjust man.

translations.ron: Dumnezeu este stânca mea cea de scăpare, Scutul meu şi puterea cea mântuitoare, Adăpostul meu cel tare şi scăparea mea! Mântuitorul meu, din necaz m-ai izbăvit!
translations.grk: ὁ Θεός μου, φύλαξ μου ἔσται μοι, πεποιθὼς ἔσομαι ἐπʼ αὐτῷ· ὑπερασπιστής μου, καὶ κέρας σωτηρίας μου, ἀντιλήπτωρ μου, καὶ καταφυγή μου σωτηρίας μου, ἐξ ἀδίκου σώσεις με.

verses.translation: I will call upon the Lord who is worthy to be praised, and I shall be saved from my enemies.

translations.ron: Pe Domnul Cel vrednic de laudă L-am chemat Şi de vrăjmaşii mei am fost izbăvit.
translations.grk: Αἰνετὸν ἐπικαλέσομαι Κύριον, καὶ ἐκ τῶν ἐχθρῶν μου σωθήσομαι.

verses.translation: For the troubles of death compassed me, the floods of iniquity amazed me:

translations.ron: Valurile morţii mă-mpresuraseră Şi eram potopit de şuvoaiele răutăţii;
translations.grk: Ὅτι περιέσχον με συντριμμοὶ θανάτου, χείμαῤῥοι ἀνομίας ἐθάμβησάν με.

verses.translation: the pangs of death surrounded me, the agonies of death prevented me.

translations.ron: Lanţurile iadului mă încătuşaseră şi eram prins în lanţurile morţii.
translations.grk: Ὠδῖνες θανάτου ἐκύκλωσάν με, προέφθασάν με σκληρότητες θανάτου.

verses.translation: When I am afflicted I will call upon the Lord, and will cry to my God, and he shall hear my voice out of his temple, and my cry shall come into his ears.

translations.ron: Dar în necazul meu am chemat pe Domnul, Strigăt am înălţat către Dumnezeul meu Şi El mi-a auzit glasul din locaşul Său Şi strigătul meu a ajuns la urechile Lui.
translations.grk: Ἐν τῷ θλίβεσθαί με ἐπικαλέσομαι τὸν Κύριον, καὶ πρὸς τὸν Θεόν μου βοήσομαι, καὶ ἐπακούσεται ἐκ ναοῦ αὐτοῦ φωνῆς μου, καὶ ἡ κραυγή μου ἐν τοῖς ὠσὶν αὐτοῦ.

verses.translation: And the earth was troubled and quaked, and the foundations of heaven were confounded and torn asunder, because the Lord was wroth with them.

translations.ron: Atunci s-a clătinat şi s-a cutremurat pământul, Şi temeliile cerurilor s-au zguduit, Pentru că Se mâniase Domnul!
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐταράχθη καὶ ἐσείσθη ἡ γῆ, καὶ τὰ θεμέλια τοῦ οὐρανοῦ συνεταράχθησαν καὶ ἐσπαράχθησαν, ὃτι ἐθυμώθη Κύριος αὐτοῖς.

verses.translation: There went up a smoke in his wrath, and fire out of his mouth devours: coals were kindled at it.

translations.ron: Fum ieşea din nările Lui, Din gura Lui ieşea foc mistuitor Şi cărbuni aprinşi ţâşneau.
translations.grk: Ἀνέβη καπνὸς ἐν τῇ ὀργῇ αὐτοῦ, καὶ πῦρ ἐκ στόματος αὐτοῦ κατέδεται· ἄνθρακες ἐξεκαύθησαν ἀπʼ αὐτοῦ.

verses.translation: And he bowed the heavens, and came down, and there was darkness under his feet.

translations.ron: Plecat-a cerurile şi S-a coborât Şi sub picioarele Lui era negură deasă.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἔκλινεν οὐρανοὺς καὶ κατέβη, καὶ γνόφος ὑποκάτω τῶν ποδῶν αὐτοῦ.

verses.translation: And he rode upon the cherubs and did fly, and was seen upon the wings of the wind.

translations.ron: Şezut-a pe heruvimi şi a zburat, zburat-a pe aripile vântului!
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐπεκάθισεν ἐπὶ τῷ χερουβὶν καὶ ἐπετάσθη, καὶ ὤφθη ἐπὶ πτερύγων ἀνέμου.

verses.translation: And he made darkness his hiding-place; his tabernacle round about him was the darkness of waters, he condensed it with the clouds of the air.

translations.ron: Din negură Şi-a făcut adăpost Şi cort împrejurul Său; Cu ape întunecoase şi cu nori negri era înfăşurat.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἔθετο σκότος ἀποκρυφὴν αὐτοῦ· κύκλῳ αὐτοῦ ἡ σκηνὴ αὐτοῦ σκότος ὑδάτων, ἐπάχυνεν ἐν νεφέλαις ἀέρος.

verses.translation: At the brightness before him coals of fire were kindled.

translations.ron: De strălucirea ce-I mergea înainte Se împrăştiau norii, Aruncând grindină şi cărbuni de foc.
translations.grk: Ἀπὸ τοῦ φέγγους ἐναντίον αὐτοῦ ἐξεκαύθησαν ἄνθρακες πυρός.

verses.translation: The Lord thundered out of heaven, and the Most High uttered his voice.

translations.ron: Atunci Domnul a tunat în ceruri Şi Cel Preaînalt a făcut să răsuna glasul Său;
translations.grk: Ἐβρόντησεν ἐξ οὐρανοῦ Κύριος, καὶ ὁ ὕψιστος ἔδωκε φωνὴν αὐτοῦ.

verses.translation: And he sent forth arrows, and scattered them, and he flashed lightning, and dismayed them.

translations.ron: Slobozit-a săgeţile Sale şi a împrăştiat pe vrăjmaşi, Înmulţitu-Şi-a fulgerele şi i-a pus pe fugă.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἀπέστειλε βέλη, καὶ ἐσκόρπισεν αὐτούς· καὶ ἢστραψεν ἀστραπὴν, καὶ ἐξέστησεν αὐτούς.

verses.translation: And the channels of the sea were seen, and the foundations of the world were discovered, at the rebuke of the Lord, at the blast of the breath of his anger.

translations.ron: De certarea Ta, Doamne, De suflarea nărilor Tale, S-au arătat fundurile mării Şi temeliile lumii s-au descoperit.
translations.grk: Καὶ ὤφθησαν ἀφέσεις θαλάσσης, καὶ ἀπεκαλύφθη θεμέλια τῆς οἰκουμένης ἐν τῇ ἐπιτιμήσει Κυρίου, ἀπὸ πνοῆς πνεύματος θυμοῦ αὐτοῦ.

verses.translation: He sent from above and took me; he drew me out of many waters.

translations.ron: Tinzându-Şi El mâna de sus, m-a apucat Şi m-a scos din ape adânci;
translations.grk: Ἀπέστειλεν ἐξ ὕξ ὕψους καὶ ἔλαβέ με, εἵλκυσέ με ἐξ ὑδάτων πολλῶν.

verses.translation: He delivered me from my strong enemies, from them that hated me, for they were stronger than I.

translations.ron: Izbăvitu-m-a de vrăjmaşul meu cel puternic, De cei ce mă urau şi erau mai tari ca mine:
translations.grk: Ἐῤῥύσατό με ἐξ ἐχθρῶν μου ἰσχύος, ἐκ τῶν μισούντων με, ὅτι ἐκραταιώθησαν ὑπὲρ ἐμέ.

verses.translation: The days of my affliction prevented me; but the Lord was my stay.

translations.ron: Aceştia mă împresuraseră în ziua necazului, Dar Domnul a fost ajutorul meu;
translations.grk: Προέφθασάν με ἡμέραι θλίψεώς μου· καὶ ἐγένετο Κύριος ἐπιστήριγμά μου;

verses.translation: And he brought me into a wide place, and rescued me, because he delighted in me.

translations.ron: El m-a scos le loc larg, izbăvitu-m-a, pentru că m-a iubit!
translations.grk: καὶ ἐξήγαγέ με εἰς πλατυσμὸν, καὶ ἐξείλετό με, ὅτι ηὐδόκησες ἐν ἐμοί.

verses.translation: And the Lord recompensed me according to my righteousness; even according to the purity of my hands did he recompense me.

translations.ron: Domnul mi-a dat după nevinovăţia mea, După curăţia mâinilor mele mi-s plătit.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἀνταπέδωκέ μοι Κύριος κατὰ τὴν δικαιοσύνην μου, καὶ κατὰ τὴν καθαριότητα τῶν χειρῶν μου ἀνταπέδωκέ μοι.

verses.translation: Because I kept the ways of the Lord, and did not wickedly depart from my God.

translations.ron: Căci am urmat căile Domnului, Şi înaintea Dumnezeului meu m-am pocăit.
translations.grk: Ὅτι ἐφύλαξα ὁδοὺς Κυρίου, καὶ οὐκ ἠσέβησα ἀπὸ τοῦ Θεοῦ μου.

verses.translation: For all his judgments and his ordinances were before me: I departed not from them.

translations.ron: Toate poruncile Lui le-am avut înaintea mea Şi de la legea Lui nu m-am abătut.
translations.grk: Ὅτι πάντα τὰ κρίματα αὐτοῦ κατεναντίον μου καὶ τὰ δικαιώματα αὐτοῦ, οὐκ ἀπέστην ἀπʼ αὐτῶν.

verses.translation: And I shall be blameless before him, and will keep myself from my iniquity.

translations.ron: Fără prihană am fost înaintea Lui Şi de nedreptate m-am păzit.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἔσομαι ἄμωμος αὐτῷ, καὶ προφυλάξομαι ἀπὸ τῆς ἀνομίας μου.

verses.translation: And the Lord will recompense me according to my righteousness, and according to the purity of my hands in his eye-sight.

translations.ron: Deci Domnul mi-a plătit după nevinovăţia mea Şi după curăţia mâinilor mele pe care a cunoscut-o.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἀποδώσει μοι Κύριος κατὰ τὴν δικαιοσύνην μου, καὶ κατὰ τὴν καθαριότητα τῶν χειρῶν μου ἐνώπιον τῶν ὀφθαλμῶν αὐτοῦ.

verses.translation: With the holy thou wilt be holy, and with the perfect man thou wilt be perfect,

translations.ron: Căci Tu, Doamne, cu cel bun Te arăţi bun, Cu omul drept Te porţi cu dreptate,
translations.grk: Μετὰ ὁσίου ὁσιωθήσῃ, καὶ μετὰ ἀνδρὸς τελείου τελειωθήσῃ·

verses.translation: and with the excellent thou wilt be excellent, and with the froward thou wilt be froward.

translations.ron: Cu cel cuvios, Cuvios eşti, Iar cu cel îndărătnic, Te porţi după îndărătnicia lui.
translations.grk: Καὶ μετὰ ἐκλεκτοῦ ἐκλεκτὸς ἔσῃ, καὶ μετὰ στρεβλοῦ στρεβλωθήσῃ.

verses.translation: And thou wilt save the poor people, and wilt bring down the eyes of the haughty.

translations.ron: Tu pe poporul smerit îl izbăveşti, Iar ochii cei mândri îi smereşti.
translations.grk: Καὶ τὸν λαὸν τὸν πτωχὸν σώσεις, καὶ ὀφθαλμοὺς ἐπὶ μετεώρων ταπεινώσεις.

verses.translation: For thou, Lord, art my lamp, and the Lord shall shine forth to me in my darkness.

translations.ron: Tu eşti lumina mea, Doamne! Doamne, luminează întunericul meu!
translations.grk: Ὅτι σὺ ὁ λύχνος μου Κύριε, καὶ Κύριος ἐκλάμψει μοι τὸ σκότος μου.

verses.translation: For by thee shall I run as a girded man, and by my God shall I leap over a wall.

translations.ron: Cu Tine mă voi arunca spre oştirea înarmată, Cu Dumnezeul meu voi doborî zidul.
translations.grk: Ὅτι ἐν σοὶ δραμοῦμαι μονόζωνος, καὶ ἐν τῷ Θεῷ μου ὑπερβήσομαι τεῖχος.

verses.translation: As for the Mighty One, his way is blameless: the word of the Lord is strong and tried in the fire: he is a protector to all that put their trust in him.

translations.ron: Căile Domnului sunt desăvârşite, Cuvântul Domnului e lămurit prin foc. Şi scut este El tuturor celor ce nădăjduiesc în El;
translations.grk: Ὁ ἰσχυρὸς ἄμωμος ἡ ὁδὸς αὐτοῦ· τὸ ῥῆμα Κυρίου κραταιὸν πεπυρωμένον· ὑπερασπιστής ἐστι πᾶσι τοῖς πεποιθόσιν ἐπʼ αὐτόν.

verses.translation: Who is strong, but the Lord? and who will be a Creator except our God?

translations.ron: Căci cine este Dumnezeu, dacă nu Domnul? Şi cine este apărător, dacă nu Dumnezeul nostru?
translations.grk: Τίς ἰσχυρὸς πλὴν Κυρίου; καὶ τίς κτίστης ἔσται πλὴν τοῦ Θεοῦ ἡμῶν;

verses.translation: It is the Mighty One who strengthens me with might, and has prepared my way without fault.

translations.ron: Dumnezeu este Cel ce mă încinge cu putere şi calea cea dreaptă-mi arată;
translations.grk: Ὁ ἰσχυρὸς ὁ κραταιῶν με δυνάμει, καὶ ἐξετίναξεν ἄμωμον τὴν ὁδόν μου.

verses.translation: He makes my feet like harts' feet, and sets me upon the high places.

translations.ron: Care dă picioarelor mele sprinteneala cerbului, Şi la locurile cele înalte mă aşează;
translations.grk: Τιθεὶς τοὺς πόδας μου ὡς ἐλάφων, καὶ ἐπὶ τὰ ὕψη ἱστῶν με.

verses.translation: He teaches my hands to war, and has broken a brazen bow by my arm.

translations.ron: Care-mi deprinde mâinile mele la război Şi braţele mele să întindă arzul de aramă.
translations.grk: Διδάσκων χεῖράς μου εἰς πόλεμον, καὶ κατάξας τόξον χαλκοῦν ἐν βραχίονί μου.

verses.translation: And thou hast given me the shield of my salvation, and thy propitious dealing has increased me,

translations.ron: Doamne, Tu mă aperi cu scutul Tău izbăvitor, Cu dreapta Ta mă sprijini şi înalţi cu bunătatea Ta,
translations.grk: Καὶ ἔδωκάς μοι ὑπερασπισμὸν σωτηρίας μου, καὶ ἡ ὑπακοή σου ἐπλήθυνέ με εἰς πλατυσμὸν εἰς τὰ διαβήματά μου ὑποκάτω μου,

verses.translation: so as to make room under me for my going, and my legs did not totter.

translations.ron: Tu lărgeşti calea sub paşii mei Şi picioarele mele nu se poticnesc.
translations.grk: καὶ οὐκ ἐσαλεύθησαν τὰ σκέλη μου.

verses.translation: I will pursue my enemies, and will utterly destroy them; and I will not turn again till I have consumed them.

translations.ron: Urmări-voi pe vrăjmaşii mei şi-i voi prinde. Nu mă voi întoarce până nu-i stârpesc.
translations.grk: Διώξω ἐχθρούς μου, καὶ ἀφανιῶ αὐτοὺς, καὶ οὐκ ἀναστρέψω ἕως ἂν συντελέσω αὐτούς.

verses.translation: And I will crush them, and they shall not rise; and they shall fall under my feet.

translations.ron: Îi voi lovi şi nu se vor putea ţine. Cădea-vor sub picioarele mele.
translations.grk: Καὶ θλάσω αὐτοὺς καὶ οὐκ ἀναστήσονται, καὶ πεσοῦνται ὑπὸ τοὺς πόδας μου.

verses.translation: And thou shalt strengthen me with power for the war; thou shalt cause them that rise up against me to bow down under me.

translations.ron: Tu mă încingi cu putere pentru război Şi faci să cadă potrivnicii sub mine
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐνισχύσεις με δυνάμει εἰς πόλεμον, κάμψεις τοὺς ἐπιστανομένους μοι ὑποκάτω μου.

verses.translation: And thou hast caused mine enemies to flee before me, even them that hated me, and thou hast slain them.

translations.ron: Pe vrăjmaşii mei Tu-i pui pe fugă înaintea mea şi pe cei ce mă urăsc îi spulberi.
translations.grk: Καὶ τοὺς ἐχθρούς μου ἔδωκάς μοι νῶτον, τοὺς μισοῦντάς με, καὶ ἐθανάτωσας αὐτούς.

verses.translation: They shall cry, and there shall be no helper; to the Lord, but he hearkens not to them.

translations.ron: Striga-vor, dar nimeni nu-i va scăpa, Pe Domnul vor striga, dar nu-i va auzi;
translations.grk: Βοήσονται, καὶ οὐκ ἔστι βοηθὸς, πρὸς Κύριον, καὶ οὐκ ἐπήκουσεν αὐτῶν.

verses.translation: And I ground them as the dust of the earth, I beat them small as the mire of the streets.

translations.ron: Ca praful ce-l ia vântul îi voi pisa şi-i voi călca în picioare ca tina uliţelor.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐλέανα αὐτοὺς ὡς χοῦν γῆς, ὡς πηλὸν ἐξόδων ἐλέπτυνα αὐτούς.

verses.translation: And thou shalt deliver me from the striving of the peoples, thou shalt keep me to be the head of the Gentiles: a people which I knew not served me.

translations.ron: Tu mă izbăveşti de răzvrătirea poporului Şi în fruntea neamurilor mă pui.
translations.grk: Καὶ ῥύσῃ με ἐκ μάχης λαῶν, φυλάξεις με εἰς κεφαλὴν ἐθνῶν· λαὸς ὃν οὐκ ἔγνω ἐδούλευσάν μοι.

verses.translation: The strange children feigned obedience to me; they hearkened to me as soon as they heard.

translations.ron: Poporul pe care nu-l cunoşteam îmi slujeşte Şi dintr-un cuvânt mi se supune.
translations.grk: Υἱοὶ ἀλλότριοι ἐψεύσαντό μοι, εἰς ἀκοὴν ὠτίου ἤκουσάν μου.

verses.translation: The strange children shall be cast away, and shall be overthrown out of their hiding-places.

translations.ron: Fiii celor de alt neam pălesc de frică şi tremură în zidurile cetăţii lor.
translations.grk: Υἱοὶ ἀλλότριοι ἀποῤῥιφήσονται, καὶ σφαλοῦσιν ἐκ τῶν συγκλεισμῶν αὐτῶν.

verses.translation: The Lord lives, and blessed be my guardian, and my God, my strong keeper, shall be exalted.

translations.ron: Viu este Domnul şi binecuvântat este numele Lui! Lăudat fie Dumnezeu, Cel ce mă izbăveşte,
translations.grk: Ζῇ Κύριος, καὶ εὐλογητὸς ὁ φύλαξ μου, καὶ ὑψωθήσεται ὁ Θεός μου ὁ φύλαξ τῆς σωτηρίας μου.

verses.translation: The Lord who avenges me is strong, chastening the nations under me,

translations.ron: Dumnezeu, Cel ce mă răzbună, Care pune popoarele sub stăpânirea mea Şi de vrăjmaşii mei mă izbăveşte.
translations.grk: Ἰσχυρὸς Κύριος ὁ διδοὺς ἐκδικήσεις ἐμοὶ, παιδεύων λαοὺς ὑποκάτω μου,

verses.translation: and bringing me out from my enemies: and thou shalt set me on high from among those that rise up against me: thou shalt deliver me from the violent man.

translations.ron: Doamne, Tu mă înalţi peste vrăjmaşii mei Şi de omul nedrept mă izbăveşti.
translations.grk: καὶ ἐξάγων με ἐξ ἐχθρῶν μου· καὶ ἐκ τῶν ἐπεγειρομένων μοι ὑψώσεις με, ἐξ ἀνδρὸς ἀδικημάτων ῥύσῃ με.

verses.translation: Therefore will I confess to thee, O Lord, among the Gentiles, and sing to thy name.

translations.ron: De aceea Te voi lăuda printre popoare şi voi da slavă numelui Tău,
translations.grk: Διὰ τοῦτο ἐξομολογήσομαί σοι Κύριε ἐν τοῖς ἔθνεσι, καὶ ἐν τῷ ὀνόματί σου ψαλῶ.

verses.translation: He magnifies the salvation of his king, and works mercy for his anointed, even for David and for his seed for ever.

translations.ron: Cel ce dă biruinţă strălucită regelui Său Şi face milă cu unsul Său, David, Şi cu urmaşii lui din veac în veac".
translations.grk: Μεγαλύνων τὰς σωτηρίας βασιλέως αὐτοῦ, καὶ ποιῶν ἔλεος τῷ χριστῷ αὐτοῦ τῷ Δαυὶδ, καὶ τῷ σπέρματι αὐτοῦ ἕως αἰῶνος. Καὶ οὗτοι οἱ λόγοι Δαυὶδ οἱ ἔσχατοι·
